citations.title: Electrical safety
citations.snippet: If the piece sparks, smells of burning, or the cord gets hot, unplug it and stop using it. We treat that as critical urgency. Do not open the socket or touch bare wires.

citations.title: Order number
citations.snippet: Order numbers look like ORB- followed by 3 to 6 digits, for example ORB-1042. They are printed on the receipt and the commission email. A new piece does not need a number.

messages.content: Hello, I'm Mara from ORB Atelier in Valencia. We restore lamps, furniture, and small upholstery. Tell me what needs restoring and, if you can, your name and an email or a phone number.
Hello, I am Ana Ruiz, ana.ruiz@example.com. My lamp from order ORB-1042 is broken and it sparks. Please call me in the morning.

Ana, unplug the lamp and do not use it. Sparks are a critical urgency. I have noted order ORB-1042 and we will call you in the morning.

Please confirm these details:
Name: Ana Ruiz
Email: ana.ruiz@example.com
Phone: —
Order: ORB-1042
Piece: Lamp
Reason: Electrical fault
Urgency: critical
Description: Hello, I am Ana Ruiz, ana.ruiz@example.com. My lamp from order ORB-1042 is broken and it sparks. Please call me in the morning.
Reply yes to file the request, or tell me what to change.
Done. Your request is filed as AT-0DD75D. The workshop will use the contact you gave us. If the piece sparks or smells of burning, keep it unplugged.
